=== Case 5 ===
ISSUE:
`auto_mkdir` broken in `setitems`
When writing array data to a nested path, I get a FileNotFoundError for the file that is supposed to be written. This is because the parent directory does not exist, althoug fsspec should create it when needed. This is especially a problem with [`zarr`](https://github.com/zarr-developers/zarr-python/) (e.g. 2.16.1) which [does something](https://github.com/zarr-developers/zarr-python/blame/4944e66cd847a6ab5ec3a70c2b7bc0973f707bd6/zarr/storage
